name: Hereditary Diffuse Gastric Cancer

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: International Gastric Cancer Linkage Consortium (IGCLC) Criteria

criteria.description: Two or more cases of diffuse gastric cancer in first- or second-degree relatives, with at least one diagnosed before age 50
Presence of pathogenic germline CDH1 mutation
Personal or family history of lobular breast cancer in a CDH1 mutation carrier
Diffuse gastric cancer diagnosed before age 40

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a pathogenic CDH1 mutation or two major criteria including family history and early onset diffuse gastric cancer
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing for CDH1 mutations is critical for confirmation; prophylactic gastrectomy is recommended for mutation carriers.

occasional.notes: Related to anemia and cancer cachexia

laboratory: Microcytic anemia due to chronic blood loss
imaging: Diffuse thickening of the gastric wall on CT or MRI
Endoscopic findings often subtle; random biopsies required
genetic: Pathogenic germline mutations in CDH1 gene
Loss of E-cadherin protein expression in tumor tissue
other: Histopathology showing signet ring cell carcinoma
Family pedigree consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of multiple colorectal adenomatous polyps
Predominantly colorectal cancer risk rather than diffuse gastric cancer

redFlags: Multiple family members with diffuse gastric cancer diagnosed before age 50
Known pathogenic CDH1 mutation in the family
Early onset lobular breast cancer in female relatives
references: Hansford S, Kaurah P, Li-Chang H, et al. Hereditary Diffuse Gastric Cancer Syndrome: CDH1 Mutations and Beyond. JAMA Oncol. 2015;1(1):23-32.
International Gastric Cancer Linkage Consortium. Hereditary Diffuse Gastric Cancer: Updated Clinical Practice Guidelines. Gut. 2015;64(7):1103-1113.
Pharoah PD, Guilford P, Caldas C. Incidence of gastric cancer and CDH1 mutations in families with hereditary diffuse gastric cancer. Lancet Oncol. 2001;2(8):533-535.
